title: Secure remote access and a persistent system browser
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.6 adds opt-in Tailscale remote access and a persistent native Browser for authentication, documentation, and ordinary web use without leaving the Cloudless desktop.
changes: Add Browser as a permanent Cloudless desktop tool backed by a separate persistent Firefox or Chromium profile with native tabs, history, bookmarks, and downloads.
Keep Browser above the fullscreen Cloudless kiosk, show its running state in the dock, and restore a minimized Browser from the same dock icon.
Route external Cloudless links through Browser instead of opening browser-native popups or embedding websites that prohibit framing.
Add Settings > Remote access with optional Tailscale installation, account connection, device identity, tailnet address, private Cloudless Serve, and Tailscale SSH controls.
Install the official Tailscale Linux client after a normal boot while keeping it logged out and all sharing disabled until the user opts in.
Keep Tailscale authentication and credentials outside CloudlessOS by completing sign-in in the dedicated Browser.
Polish system action buttons so icons and labels stay correctly aligned across Remote access, Engine, and API access settings.
